Nia (Support): FYI Cobalt AI reached out — they received a $1,120 overage on INV-2026-1110 after a migration test spilled into production window. They say it was supposed to be throttled.
Ricardo (Finance): can you paste the invoice lines and the usage window? want to confirm what portion is legitimate usage vs test spill.
Nia (Support): Snapshot: INV-2026-1110
- Hosted API regular usage: $2,300
- Burst overage (2026-11-02 01:05-01:35 UTC): $1,120
Total: $3,420
Nia (Support): Customer claim: migration job ran longer than expected and hit prod rate limits; they asked for a partial goodwill credit since they were running scheduled migration (not normal traffic).
Kayla (Billing Ops): Policy check: we generally offer full credit for system-caused charges, partial (50%) for customer-caused test spills if they were transparent ahead of time. Did they notify support ahead?
Nia (Support): They opened a ticket before the window saying "migration tonight, expect some background traffic" but didn't request explicit exemption. Ticket: #SUP-5072 (mentioning migration but no formal quota override).
Ricardo (Finance): Given they warned but didn't request a quota change, recommend 50% goodwill on the overage = $560. Approver needed: ricardo_finance (>=$500).
Kayla (Billing Ops): Preparing credit request: ```billing-cli credit create --invoice INV-2026-1110 --amount 560 --currency USD --reason "partial goodwill credit for migration spill (50%)" --approver ricardo_finance --metadata ticket=SUP-5072,customer=CobaltAI```
billing-bot: Credit request submitted: CR-2026-15432 pending approval. Link: https://billing.internal/credits/CR-2026-15432
Ricardo (Finance): Approved. Memo: "partial goodwill credit per policy: customer warned but did not request exemption; remedial: prod throttles doc and migration-runbook to prevent future spills."
billing-bot: CR-2026-15432 APPROVED by ricardo_finance at 2026-11-02T09:02:10Z. Credit applied: $560. New invoice balance: $2,860. Credit note generated and emailed to customer.
Nia (Support): Notified Cobalt AI with outreach copy: "Thanks — we applied a $560 goodwill credit for the migration spill. For future migrations, please request a temporary quota override and follow the migration runbook to avoid charges." Customer replied: "Thanks, that works. We'll coordinate next time." :thumbsup:
eng-oncall-bot: Created follow-up JIRA BILL-643 to add a visible migration guidance page and a self-serve temporary quota override UI.
Kayla (Billing Ops): I'll include this credit in the November adjustments report and mark as "partial-goodwill" category. Closing thread.
